title: Local-Unitary Rigidity and Quantitative Rounding for Stabilizer AME States
description: This preprint proves factorwise local-Clifford rigidity for product-unitary intertwiners of additive stabilizer absolutely maximally entangled states. A quantitative three-region cleaning and Weyl–Fourier argument gives explicit Clifford rounding, a defect-only decomposition radius, robust minimum-support-atlas compatibility, and an exact affine-character obstruction.
